anomalies.observed: On the EPD_Driver sheet, the capacitor C2 sitting on the Display_Power_Switch (EPD VDD) net next to L1 is drawn with value '10uF/6.3V'.
anomalies.expected: The specification states that the Meshinger schematic uses the Pervasive-Displays G1-group-specific 1 uF / 6.3 V capacitor in this position (designator C2), and that this value match is what identifies the panel as a 2.13" Waveshare G1 part.

evidence.quote: C2  10uF/6.3V  (EPD_Driver sheet, on the Display_Power_Switch net immediately left of L1)
| C1 (G1 group only): 1 µF/6.3 V | C2 = 1 µF/6.3 V | Matches G1-specific value |

anomalies.impact: The bulk/bypass capacitance on the e-paper VDD rail is ten times the intended value and the G1-group value match used to confirm the reference circuit is broken. Electrically this is minor on a 3.3 V rail, but the built board no longer matches the specified BOM.

anomalies.observed: On the EPD_Driver sheet, capacitor C1 on the Display_Power_Switch net is drawn with value '0.1uF/16V'.
anomalies.expected: The specification lists C1 together with C5/C7/C8/C9/C10 as one of the 1 uF / 25 V capacitors of the EPD driver circuit.

evidence.quote: C1  0.1uF/16V  (EPD_Driver sheet, left of C2 on the Display_Power_Switch net)
| C2 default: 1 µF/25 V | C1/C5/C7/C8/C9/C10 = 1 µF/25 V | Matches default |

anomalies.impact: The value is ten times lower and the voltage rating is 16 V instead of the specified 25 V, so the EPD VDD decoupling network departs from the specified reference values.

parsed.summary: The only discrepancies found between the drawn schematic and the specified design are the two EPD-driver VDD decoupling capacitors: C1 is drawn as 0.1 uF/16 V where the specification lists 1 uF/25 V, and C2 is drawn as 10 uF/6.3 V where the specification (and the Pervasive Displays G1 reference it matches) requires 1 uF/6.3 V.
